message: Combine the trial outcomes with the lab results by patient and plot biomarker against ALT for each patient.
When I select patients in the outcomes chart, highlight the same patients in the lab results chart.
Add a filter panel so I can filter the trial by arm, sex and biomarker range.
Give me a filter panel on the lab results that also filters the trial outcome charts.
Use R to compute the mean biomarker per arm and chart it.
With Python, compute revenue per unit for each region and show it as a bar chart.
Left-join the labs onto the trial so every trial patient is kept, and show the combined table.
Add a filter panel for region and save a filter scheme called 'North only' that keeps just North.
